summary: Updated SessionTreeScreen.svelte to use sessionState for tree revision tracking and add a fallback for the selected entry, restyled the tree trigger button in Conversation.svelte as ghost with a tooltip, added muted/hover styling for it in conversation.css, and extended FakeAgentClient and integration tests to cover branching/alternate-path behavior.
decisions: SessionTreeScreen.svelte `treeRevision` now derives from `store.sessionState` (with a fallback to sessionId+messageCount) so the tree refreshes on state changes.
SessionTreeScreen.svelte `selected` falls back to the last active row when `selectedId` does not match any entry, improving selection resilience.
Conversation.svelte tree trigger Button changed to ghost variant with `title="Browse alternate paths"` and `data-ui="tree-trigger"` for accessibility and consistent styling.
errors: Prettier --check failed on 4 files (SessionTreeScreen.svelte, SessionTreeActions.svelte, fake-client/sessions.ts, sessions/session-operations.ts); resolved by running prettier --write on the affected files.
